headline: Lockheed Martin stock rises on elevated global defense order volume
summary: Lockheed Martin shares gained as strong national security demand for defense and aerospace systems supported company order backlogs and revenue growth.
why: Lockheed Martin is a major global defense contractor specializing in aerospace and military hardware.

impacts.name: Lockheed Martin Corporation
impacts.why: Persistent international security demand strengthens projected revenue streams for defense systems.

why_moved: Strong ongoing demand for defense hardware boosted buyer interest in Lockheed Martin shares.
